ticker_news.title: Prediction: This Will Be TSMC's Stock Price in 2026
ticker_news.description: TSMC is expected to experience significant growth in 2026 due to strong AI chip demand, increased advanced chip packaging capacity, and potential price increases for advanced chip nodes. Analysts predict the stock could potentially rise 67% to $481 per share.
ticker_news.author: Harsh Chauhan

ticker_news.title: The $6.7 Trillion AI Buildout: How Data Centers and Power Became a Growth Engine
ticker_news.description: The AI infrastructure buildout is projected to require $6.7 trillion in global data center investments by 2030, with $1.3 trillion allocated to power generation and transmission, transforming utility infrastructure into a high-demand growth sector.
ticker_news.author: Jeff Buchbinder
